wiki.title: Frank J. Mrvan
wiki.extract: Frank John Mrvan ( mər-VAN; born April 16, 1969) is an American politician who has served as the U.S. representative for Indiana's 1st congressional district since 2021. From 2005 until 2021, he served as the township trustee for North Township, Indiana. Mrvan is a member of the Democratic Party.
